Here at KAM we consider ourselves to be the number one stop for all your clutch repair needs.

Clutch repairs can sometimes be complicated jobs, so it is important to get it right first time.

We have many years experience replacing clutches on all makes and models of car and light commercial vehicles.

Free Clutch Check
If you suspect you are having clutch or gearbox problems then please call in for a free while-u-wait clutch check.

Our talented technicians will be able to tell if your clutch is at fault before we start work on your vehicle.

Save up to 50% on Main Dealer prices.
We only fit original equipment clutches from LUK and Valeo, these are the same quality parts that the main dealers supply and fit.

If your vehicle requires a clutch repair that will leave you without a car for more than a day, we can provide you with one of our courtesy cars as a replacement.

All our courtesy cars are available free of charge, all we ask is that you replace any fuel used.

Call today for a competitive quote or ask a question below and we'll get back to you.

Quality clutch repairs.
Contact Your Local Branch For a Quote.
